We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Do you enjoy solving complex problems and troubleshooting products? The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Business intelligence engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

The challenges business intelligence engineers solve for at Amazon are big and affect millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. - Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
- Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
- Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
- Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
- Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
- Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).

A day in the life
Our Business Intelligence Engineer builds data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and analyses to deliver metrics and insights to the business.
Our Business Intelligence Engineers tackle some of the most complex challenges in large scale
computing, work in small teams across the company to contribute to the e-commerce platform that's used by millions of people all over the world. With that in mind, we require applicants to demonstrate their technical skills in a number of areas.

- Competitive salary
- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
- Mentorship and career development

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies.

Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, NET/C#, ASPNET Core, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, MS Orleans, Kafka

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Support Escalations Specialist, you will be an early member of our internal high-stakes response team. Internal Escalations are a critical component of what we do in Support. Our community of internal stakeholders continuously advocate for our customers, and this team is a center point of that. We are building on all the wonderful work being done today, and adding this critical internal support function to bring expertise and ensure the highest level quality and execution.

This isn't your standard customer support role. You will handle the most sensitive and high-risk cases that hit our ecosystem—cases that often have direct visibility from our executive leadership, legal, and product teams. You will be responsible for not only resolving these complex issues but also documenting the "how" and "why" to help us build a proactive, world-class internal operation.

What You’ll Do

• Own and resolve complex escalations involving legal, financial, and executive-level sensitivities with a focus on empathy and extreme accuracy.
• Act as a bridge and support conduit for our current vendor partners and our growing internal team, helping to document processes and workflows.
• You won't just complete tickets. You’ll find out why they happened. You will conduct deep-dive investigations into systemic errors, poor agent behaviors and other gaps, and advocate for fixes.
• Maintain high-integrity data on every case you handle, helping to turn raw ticket information into insights that we share with Product and Engineering teams.
• Partner directly with Product Support, Legal, Ad Ops, Developer Relations and more to provide updates on high-profile cases and emerging trends.

You Have

• 3+ years in a high-tier support, Trust & Safety, or operations role (Executive or Legal escalations experience is a massive plus).
• You enjoy "detective work." You’re comfortable digging through logs and data to find the needle in the haystack.
• You can translate complex customer challenges into clear, concise updates.
• You are comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building and partnering with vendor teams to coordinate and execute on tickets.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Operations, or a related field.

You Are

• Discreet & Reliable: You understand the sensitivity of high-risk work and can be trusted with confidential information.
• Proactive: You don’t wait for a manual to be written; you help write it.
• Resilient: You stay calm under pressure, especially when dealing with tight deadlines and high-visibility cases.
• Collaborative: You’re a team player who is happy to mentor vendor partners today and help onboard new internal peers tomorrow.

The Logistics

• This role requires collaboration with team members based in California, USA.

회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.

물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행

Business Data & Analytics is a Corporate Shared Service comprised of the existing data and analytics resources in Predictive Analytics, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Analytics, Enterprise Telematics, and Business Transformation.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

• Analyzes complex business issues and translates business questions, decisions, and terminology into requirements for trusted analytic products that improve decision-making and measurable business outcomes, supported by reusable semantic models and AI-assisted capabilities.
• Partners with business stakeholders, data owners, analytics professionals, product managers, and cross-functional product teams to define the business concepts, measures, relationships, rules, and requirements that give analytic products consistent meaning across reports, dashboards, and AI-assisted experiences.
• Designs, develops, tests, and maintains reusable semantic models as core components of analytic products, organizing business entities, measures, relationships, definitions, and access rules for reporting, self-service analytics, and agent-assisted use cases.
• Creates and maintains the business-friendly metadata, data definitions, lineage, model diagrams, and usage guidance needed for people and AI-enabled tools to interpret and use analytic products consistently.
• Develops end-user guidance and training that support adoption and effective use of analytic products.
• Manages the analytic product lifecycle by defining success measures with business partners; monitoring adoption, quality, performance, and business impact; evaluating priority questions, expected answers, failure patterns, and escalation criteria for AI-assisted experiences; and refining products and supporting semantic models as needs, data, and AI capabilities evolve.
• Advises business stakeholders on analytics and AI-assisted use cases, helping teams frame meaningful questions, interpret results, improve data literacy, and determine when human review is required.
• Partners with product managers and business leaders to prioritize opportunities, manage dependencies and risks, influence decisions, and communicate product value to executive stakeholders so analytic products are delivered incrementally and achieve intended business outcomes.

Experience designing or maintaining BI applications, analytic products, or semantic models is required. Translates business and technology knowledge into clear product direction, governed definitions, measures, relationships, rules, and solution guidance. Recommends effective practices and tools for product discovery, business analysis, semantic modeling, AI evaluation, testing, and documentation. May serve as a senior member of an agile product team and provides technical and professional guidance to less experienced team members. As a Module Equipment Technician, you will play an essential role in supporting Intel's cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing processes. You will be responsible for hands-on troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and calibration of advanced equipment in a cleanroom environment. By ensuring optimal equipment performance, you will directly contribute to improving production efficiency and driving Intel's technology advancements.

Business Group

Join Intel's Advanced Packaging Technology Development - Substrate and Wafer Assembly (APTD: SWA) team, a leader in innovative substrate packaging solutions that support Intel's global leadership in manufacturing technology. • Troubleshoot and resolve electrical and mechanical issues in manufacturing equipment.

• Collaborate with engineering and support teams to enhance equipment functionality and streamline processes.
• Document maintenance activities, repair findings, and parts usage using established systems and protocols.
• Lead or support continuous improvement projects, such as root cause analysis and equipment optimization initiatives.

• Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) with 2+ years of experience.

Job Description

We're looking for a Social Content Creator with serious creative chops and a strong strategic instinct. Someone who can look at what's happening in culture, in the industry, and in the feed and turn it into dynamic social content that makes Concentrix impossible to scroll past.
This isn't about managing channels or scheduling posts. It's about bringing creative ideas to life: translating strategy into visuals, messaging, and formats that actually land. We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. We're looking for a Social Content Creator with serious creative chops and a strong strategic instinct. Someone who can look at what's happening in culture, in the industry, and in the feed and turn it into dynamic social content that makes Concentrix impossible to scroll past.

This isn't about managing channels or scheduling posts. It's about bringing creative ideas to life: translating strategy into visuals, messaging, and formats that actually land. In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

• Collaborate with content creators and the wider social team to brief, shape, and elevate execution
• Contribute to content strategy discussions, bringing a creative POV to planning conversations

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

This is not a social media management role, and it's not a pure strategy role either. We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

Power the best version of you!
